What is Recraft?

Design-focused generator that produces true vector output (SVG) as well as raster, with brand style training and a full editing canvas - positioned for designers who need editable, scalable assets rather than flat images.

Best for

Editable vector assets and icon sets in a consistent brand style.

Main features

  • Native vector (SVG) generation that is genuinely editable in Illustrator or Figma
  • custom brand style training from reference images
  • icon and logo generation sets
  • mockup generation
  • infinite design canvas with layers
  • text-in-image support
  • image-to-vector conversion
  • background removal and upscaling
  • consistent style across an asset set
  • API.

Practical use cases

  • Generating a consistent icon set in SVG for a product
  • producing on-brand illustrations that match a defined style
  • creating editable logo concepts
  • generating vector patterns and backgrounds
  • producing a full brand asset set from one style reference.

Who is it for?

  • Graphic designers, brand designers, product designers, UI teams and agencies producing icon sets and brand assets.

Pricing, free access & limits

Freemium credit-based subscription

Plans described in the source

Free with roughly 50 daily credits. Basic around $12/mo ($10 annually, about 1,000 credits/month). Advanced around $33/mo ($27 annually, about 3,000 credits). Pro around $96/mo ($80 annually, about 10,000 credits). Enterprise/API priced separately per generation. Annual billing roughly 20% cheaper.

Free plan

Yes - free tier with daily credit refresh, but generations are public.

Free trial

Free daily credits serve as the ongoing trial.

Usage limits to consider

Credit-metered per generation; vector generation and upscaling cost more credits than raster. Free tier credits refresh daily but generations are public. Custom style training consumes credits.

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • The only generator here producing genuinely editable vector output - this is a categorical difference, not an incremental one, for design teams
  • brand style training gives real consistency across an asset set
  • the icon set generation workflow is excellent
  • SVG output means infinite scaling with no quality loss.

Limitations to consider

  • Photorealistic output is weaker than Midjourney or Firefly - it is a design tool, not a photography tool
  • generated SVGs can have messy path structures needing cleanup
  • free tier is public, unsuitable for client work
  • smaller company and community
  • credits deplete quickly on vector and upscaling operations.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web
  • API
  • Figma plugin

Languages

  • English interface and prompts

API access

Yes - Recraft API, priced per generation, with SVG output support

Integrations and exports

  • Figma plugin, API, export to SVG/PNG/JPG/Lottie

Evaluation notes

Inspect generated SVG path structure before committing to a workflow - output is editable but not always cleanly constructed. The brand style training is the differentiating feature worth evaluating first.
